source.publication: Tax Information for New Residents (GT-800025), Florida Department of Revenue
source.section: PDF page 3, 'Other Taxes and Fees', first sentence: Florida does not impose personal income tax (no state return or form lines exist)

worked: Federal AGI = wages 80,000.00 + interest 1,000.00 = 81,000.00. Federal taxable income = 81,000.00 - 15,750.00 single standard deduction = 65,250.00 (given, not tested). Florida imposes no personal income tax, so there is no state return: state taxable income 0.00, tax before credits 0.00, credits 0.00, state income tax 0.00 regardless of income.
